physical_anchor: Mines and smelts zinc, copper, and lead concentrates (with silver byproduct) at integrated operations and refineries in Peru and Brazil.
value_chain_position: Base-metal mid-tier producer with own smelting/refining — zinc-dominant multi-metal book (zinc/copper/lead/silver), fits the diversified-miners 'base-metal mid-tiers' layer better than the single-commodity copper chain.
